items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma listing nine situations in which the cotangent complex L_{B/A} vanishes: weakly etale maps, flat epimorphisms, localizations, unramified flat maps, etale maps, filtered colimits of vanishing maps, henselizations, strict henselizations, and an open placeholder item (source lines 1832-1849). The proof handles case (1) by applying the derived diagonal lemma to the surjective flat map B tensor_A B -> B to get L_{B/B tensor_A B} = 0 and then the bootstrap lemma; cases (2) to (5) are observed to be special cases of (1); case (6) is the colimit compatibility lemma; and cases (7) and (8) follow because (strict) henselizations are filtered colimits of etale ring extensions.
